meta_description:
fitness_junction on September 29, 2026: "Protein track karte ho, calories track karte ho… but fibre ka kya? 🤔

Most diets mein fibre unknowingly low reh jaata hai especially jab fruits, veggies aur whole foods daily consistently nahi ho paate.

That’s where Supply6 Fibre+ comes in. 🌱
With 5g fibre per 6g sachet, Sunfiber®️, insoluble fibre, ajwain & cumin it’s an easy way to add fibre to your everyday routine.

No thick, gloopy texture. Just mix it in water or your meal and you’re good to go. 🙌

Your daily nutrition isn’t complete without fibre.

#Supply6 #FibrePlus #DailyFibre #Supplement #Supply6fibre".
